card.name: Words before needle or test-dose terms
card.fires_on: Small modifier words (a, test, external, safety) right before a noun in injection-equipment or administration instructions, such as 'a test dose' or 'a gauge of 32'.

modes.label: Test dose or flush
modes.description: The word 'test' after 'a' before dose or flush in anesthesia and catheter instructions.

modes.label: Needle and syringe description
modes.description: A modifier before needle gauge, diameter, or syringe parts.
modes.example: needles with a gauge of 32 and<< a>> length of 4 mm
